author: PatchMyPC
text:

author: petranto
text: Hackers Stopped Hunting Passwords. Now They Want Your AI Keys. Railway says an attacker could have decrypted secrets from up to 100,000 customer workspaces. The attacker's queries put one target first: AI provider keys.

author: McM1Alex
text: Microsoft patched actively exploited Outlook zero-day (CVE-2026-124194) — crafted message file steals NTLMv2 hash. Microsoft rated it Moderate. CISA added to KEV with Nov 24 federal deadline.

author: code_falconx
text:
SECURITY ALERT: Google has patched an actively exploited Chrome zero-day.

CVE-2026-125350 is a high-severity use-after-free vulnerability in Chrome’s XML component.

Chrome 157.0.8103.50/.51 contains the fix for Windows and Mac.

Update your browser and restart it.
